crossRefs.note: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am…

translations.web: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.
translations.bsb: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
translations.kjv: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
translations.asv: they gave him wine to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted it, he would not drink.
